name: StoreDisplay – Product Display Layouts for WooCommerce
author: wpazleen

sections.description:
Store Display gives WooCommerce stores 12+ professional product layouts plus built-in wishlist analytics, product compare, quick view, direct shop page integration, layout cloning, and JSON export/import. One plugin instead of four or five.

Most store owners end up installing separate plugins for product grids, wishlists, comparison tables, and quick view popups. Store Display replaces all of them. Build WooCommerce product grids, sliders, masonry galleries, flip cards, product tables, and animated showcase layouts, then assign them directly to your shop, category, and tag pages. No coding required.

Website | Documentation | Pro Support

The only free WooCommerce layout plugin with built-in wishlist analytics, shop page integration, layout clone, and JSON export/import.

What is included in the free version

  • 12+ professional layouts: Product Grid, Card, Slider, Masonry, Product Gallery, Flip, Product Table, Product Showcase, Category Tabs, List, CTA, and Caption with 18+ hover effects
  • Shop Page Integration: assign any layout to your shop, category, or tag pages using 8 position options, including replacing the default WooCommerce product grid entirely
  • Layout Clone: duplicate any saved layout with one click
  • Export and Import (JSON): move layouts between sites, ideal for agencies and developers
  • Built-in Wishlist: floating button, modal, guest support, session persistence, and social sharing
  • Wishlist Analytics Dashboard: activity trend chart, top wishlisted products, restock opportunities, top user insights, live feed, and retention rate tracking
  • Product Compare: side-by-side table with attributes, ratings, and direct Add to Cart
  • Quick View Popup: product details, image gallery, variation selection, and Add to Cart without leaving the page
  • AJAX Filtering: filter by category, price, tag, attribute, stock, and custom taxonomy without page reload
  • Elementor Widget with live preview
  • Gutenberg Block with settings panel
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatible
  • Mobile-first responsive with independent column counts for desktop, tablet, and mobile

Shop Page Integration

Take full control of how products appear across your store without touching any code.

Assign any saved layout to your store pages using 8 position options:

  • Before Shop Content
  • After Shop Header
  • Before Product Grid
  • Between Products (Top)
  • Between Products (Middle)
  • After Product Grid
  • After Shop Content
  • Replace Product Grid (completely replaces the default WooCommerce product grid with your custom layout)

Page conditions let you target the shop page, category pages, or tag pages independently. Select your layout, pick a position, choose your pages, and save.

Layout Clone, Export and Import

Build your layout once, then reuse it across your site or share it with any store.

  • Clone Layout: duplicate any existing layout with one click; the copy is fully independent from the original
  • Export as JSON: download any layout as a JSON file
  • Import from JSON: bring that layout into any WordPress site running Store Display, ideal for agencies and multi-site setups

Wishlist Analytics Dashboard

No other free WooCommerce product layout plugin includes a built-in wishlist analytics dashboard. The dashboard shows:

  • Activity Trend Chart: daily wishlist adds and removes so you can spot demand patterns over time
  • Top Wishlisted Products: know which items customers want most before you restock
  • Restock Opportunities: out-of-stock products with high wishlist demand, flagged automatically
  • Top User Insights: your most engaged customers and how they interact with your store
  • Live Activity Feed: real-time stream of wishlist events
  • Retention Rate Tracking: how many users keep items wishlisted over time

Advanced Wishlist System

  • Floating wishlist button with live product count
  • Modal interface to manage saved items
  • Guest wishlist support, works without an account
  • Wishlist persists across browser sessions
  • Social sharing and email-your-wishlist

Product Compare

  • Side-by-side comparison of multiple products
  • Attribute, price, rating, and specification rows
  • Add to Cart directly from the compare modal
  • Compare list maintained across page navigation

Quick View

  • Instant product detail popup without page navigation
  • Full image gallery browsing inside the popup
  • Variation selection (size, color, and other attributes)
  • Add to Cart and related products inside the quick view

AJAX Product Filtering

  • Category, subcategory, and custom taxonomy filters
  • Price range slider (min and max)
  • Attribute filters: color, size, brand, and custom attributes
  • Tag, stock status, and on-sale filters
  • All filters update results without a page reload

WooCommerce Product Grid Layouts

Create responsive WooCommerce product grids with three style variations: Basic, Enhanced, and Advanced. Customize columns, spacing, borders, shadows, hover effects, and typography. Assign directly to your shop page via Shop Page Integration.

WooCommerce Product Slider and Carousel

Product sliders and carousels with autoplay, navigation arrows, pagination dots, and full touch/swipe support. Three slider variations to match different store designs.

WooCommerce Product Table

Sortable product tables with bulk actions and built-in comparison mode. Designed for B2B stores and wholesale operations where buyers need to compare specifications before ordering.

WooCommerce Product Gallery and Masonry

Masonry grids and product gallery layouts with image hover effects, lightbox integration, and automatic adjustment for different image proportions.

Flip Card Layouts

Simple Flip, 3D Flip, Slide Flip, Fade Flip, and Creative Flip. Each reveals extra product information on hover or click for an interactive browsing experience.

Caption Overlay Layouts (18+ Hover Effects)

Blinds Vertical, Blocks Zoom, Book Open, Border Reveal, Bounce, Circle Transitions, Cube Rotations, Swiper Slides, Liquid Morph, Neon Glow, Origami Fold, Particle Burst, Hologram, Glass Shatter, Magnetic Pull, Quantum Tunnel, Fire Ignition, and Matrix Rain. The most extensive caption animation library in any free WooCommerce display plugin.

Call-to-Action and Category Tab Layouts

CTA layouts with prominent buttons for conversion-focused placements. Category tab layouts with horizontal, vertical, or animated navigation for stores with multiple product categories.

Who uses Store Display

  • E-commerce stores replacing the default WooCommerce shop grid with a custom product layout
  • B2B and wholesale stores using product table layouts with compare and bulk features
  • Data-driven store owners using wishlist analytics to forecast demand before restocking
  • Agencies and developers cloning and exporting layouts across client sites
  • Mobile-first stores needing AJAX pagination and lazy loading
  • Multi-category stores using category tabs to keep large catalogues organized

Shortcode examples

[product_display layout="grid" columns="4" limit="12"]
[product_display layout="slider" autoplay="yes" arrows="yes"]
[product_display layout="table" show_compare="yes" show_quickview="yes"]<h3>Elementor Integration</h3>

1. Edit your page with Elementor
2. Search for the “Product Display” widget
3. Select your saved layout
4. Configure settings with live preview
5. Publish

Gutenberg Block

  1. Add the “Product Display” block from the block inserter
  2. Select a layout from the dropdown
  3. Configure block settings in the sidebar
  4. Preview and publish

Performance and Compatibility

  • Lazy loading for faster initial page load
  • AJAX pagination without full page reloads
  • Minified CSS and JS assets
  • CDN-ready
  • Compatible with WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, and LiteSpeed Cache
  • Tested with Astra, OceanWP, GeneratePress, Storefront, Divi, and Avada
  • Compatible with WPML, Polylang, and RTL languages
  • Works with WooCommerce currency switchers, subscriptions, and booking plugins
  • WooCommerce HPOS fully supported

Competitor Analysis

Search the WordPress plugin directory for a WooCommerce product layout plugin and a handful of names come up again and again, so it is worth being clear about where Store Display actually fits among them.

Product Layouts for WooCommerce is the closest match in scope, with general layouts, caption hover effects, product tabs, a carousel slider, and product filtering all included free. Anyone comparing the two is comparing like for like on layout variety. Where Store Display pulls ahead is in the features around the layouts: a built-in wishlist with its own analytics dashboard, product compare, quick view, Shop Page Integration with 8 position options including a full Replace Product Grid mode, and JSON export/import that moves a saved layout between sites. Product Layouts for WooCommerce’s free version stops at layouts and filtering; wishlist, compare, quick view, and shop-page placement are not part of its free feature set.

Product Slider, Product Carousel and Product Grid Gallery for WooCommerce (WooProduct Slider) covers sliders and grids well in its free tier, with strong autoplay, touch, and styling controls, plus its own import/export for slider settings. But quick view, masonry, and the product table layout are Pro-only there, and it has no wishlist, no compare, and no shop-page position system at all. Store Display includes sliders and grids alongside masonry, product tables, quick view, and wishlist analytics in a single free plugin.

Product Table & List Builder for WooCommerce is a strong, purpose-built free option if all a store needs is a searchable, sortable product table, and its table editor is more granular than Store Display’s. The tradeoff is scope: it only builds tables, and replacing the shop archive page with that table is a PRO-only feature there. Store Display’s product table is one of 12+ layout types, and Shop Page Integration, including replacing the default product grid, is included free no matter which layout is used.

Beyond those three, the other names that show up nearby are solving a different problem entirely, not a weaker version of the same one. Advanced Product Fields (Product Addons) for WooCommerce adds customer-facing input fields to a single product, letting shoppers personalize a t-shirt or configure a pizza order; it has nothing to do with how the product grid, slider, or shop page looks, and runs fine on the same store as Store Display. Product Tabs for WooCommerce does a similarly adjacent job, adding extra information tabs to a single product page (specs, shipping, FAQs) rather than changing how products are displayed across the shop.

So of the plugins that show up in a “woocommerce product layout” or “woocommerce product grid” search, only Product Layouts for WooCommerce, WooProduct Slider, and Product Table & List Builder are actually built for the same job as Store Display: changing how products are displayed. Between those three, Store Display’s combination of 12+ layout types, free wishlist analytics, product compare, quick view, Shop Page Integration, and JSON layout export/import, all in the free version, is what sets it apart.

External Libraries

  • Masonry.js (MIT License): masonry.desandro.com – responsive grid layout
  • Slick.js (MIT License): kenwheeler.github.io/slick – product carousels and sliders
  • toastmaster.js (MIT License): npmjs.com/package/toastmaster – toast notifications and modals

No data is sent to external services when using these libraries.

Connect and Support

  • Support Forum
  • Documentation
  • Report a Bug
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Product Display”
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from WordPress.org
  2. Upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/product-display
  3. Activate via Plugins > Installed Plugins

Initial Setup

Requirements: WordPress 5.9+, WooCommerce (latest recommended), PHP 7.2+

  1. After activation, go to Dashboard > Product Display
  2. Click Create New Layout and choose a layout type
  3. Configure your product filters, design, and style settings
  4. To assign to shop or category pages: go to Shop Page Integration, select your layout, choose a position and page conditions, and save
  5. Or copy the generated shortcode and paste it into any page, post, or widget
sections.faq:
Is Product Display compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. It is built exclusively for WooCommerce and tested with every major WooCommerce release, including WooCommerce HPOS. Supports standard, variable, grouped, and external products.

How is Product Display different from other WooCommerce product layout plugins?

It is the only free WooCommerce layout plugin that combines 12+ display types, including product grid, product table, product gallery, and product showcase, with a built-in wishlist analytics dashboard, product compare, quick view, direct shop page integration with 8 position options, layout cloning, and JSON export/import. Most competing plugins focus on one layout type, require separate wishlist and analytics plugins, or lock these features behind a paywall.

Can I assign a product layout directly to the WooCommerce shop page?

Yes. The Shop Page Integration feature lets you assign any saved layout to your shop page, category pages, or tag pages using 8 position options, including replacing the default WooCommerce product grid entirely. No shortcode or coding required.

What positions are available in Shop Page Integration?

Eight positions: Before Shop Content, After Shop Header, Before Product Grid, Between Products (Top), Between Products (Middle), After Product Grid, After Shop Content, and Replace Product Grid.

Can I clone an existing layout?

Yes. Any layout can be duplicated with one click from the Shortcode List. The clone is fully independent and editing it does not affect the original.

Does it support layout export and import?

Yes. Export any layout as a JSON file and import it on any WordPress site running Store Display. Good for agencies managing multiple client sites or developers who want to share layouts.

What does the Wishlist Analytics Dashboard include?

The dashboard shows an Activity Trend Chart (daily adds and removes), Top Wishlisted Products, Restock Opportunities (out-of-stock products with high wishlist demand), Top User Insights, a Live Activity Feed, and Retention Rate tracking.

Does it work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and tested with the latest WooCommerce versions.

Can I use multiple layouts on the same page?

Yes. Place multiple shortcodes or Elementor widgets on the same page, each with its own layout type, styling, and product selection.

Is it mobile-responsive?

Yes. All product layouts use a mobile-first approach with independently configurable column counts for desktop, tablet, and mobile. AJAX pagination and lazy loading keep performance fast on all devices.

Can I customize colors, fonts, and spacing?

Yes. The plugin includes color pickers, typography controls, spacing options, border settings, shadow effects, and hover animation choices. No CSS required, though a Custom CSS field is also available for advanced adjustments.

Does it support product variations and attributes?

Yes. Variable, grouped, external, and all product attribute types are supported. Customers can select variations from the product grid or the quick view popup.

Can customers filter products without a page reload?

Yes. The AJAX filtering system supports category, price range, tag, attribute, stock status, and custom taxonomy filtering, all without page navigation.

Is the wishlist feature really free?

Yes. Store Display includes a complete wishlist system with floating button, modal interface, guest support, session persistence, social sharing, and a full analytics dashboard in the free version.

Can shoppers compare products side by side?

Yes. The compare feature lets customers view multiple products in a table showing prices, attributes, ratings, and specifications, with a direct Add to Cart button.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. A dedicated Elementor widget with live preview is included. Changes appear in real time inside the Elementor editor.

Is it compatible with multilingual sites?

Yes. Compatible with WPML, Polylang, and other translation plugins. Translation-ready with RTL support.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The plugin uses lazy image loading, minified assets, efficient database queries, AJAX pagination, and is compatible with major caching plugins including WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, and W3 Total Cache.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. A premium version with additional layouts, advanced customization, and priority support is available. The free version already includes all core layouts, wishlist with analytics, compare, quick view, shop page integration, clone, and export/import.

How is Store Display different from Product Layouts for WooCommerce?

Product Layouts for WooCommerce matches Store Display on general layout variety, but its free version stops there. Store Display adds a built-in wishlist with its own analytics dashboard, product compare, quick view, Shop Page Integration with 8 position options, and JSON layout export/import, all in the free version.

Is Store Display a good free alternative to WooProduct Slider?

Yes, if you need more than sliders and grids. WooProduct Slider’s free tier covers sliders and grids well, but quick view, masonry, and product tables are Pro-only, and it has no wishlist or compare feature. Store Display includes sliders, grids, masonry, product tables, quick view, and wishlist analytics together in the free version.

How does Store Display compare to Product Table & List Builder for WooCommerce?

Product Table & List Builder is a dedicated table plugin with a more granular table editor, but replacing the shop page with that table is a PRO-only feature. Store Display’s product table is one of 12+ layout types, and Shop Page Integration, including replacing the default product grid, is included free.

Can I use Store Display alongside Advanced Product Fields or Product Tabs for WooCommerce?

Yes. Both of those plugins solve a different problem: Advanced Product Fields adds personalization inputs to a single product, and Product Tabs adds extra information tabs to the product page. Neither changes how products are displayed across the shop, so both run fine alongside Store Display.

What is the best free WooCommerce plugin for shop page layouts with a wishlist?

Store Display is one of the few free WooCommerce layout plugins with a built-in wishlist that includes its own analytics dashboard (activity trends, top wishlisted products, and restock opportunities). Most layout plugins in this category either skip wishlist features entirely or lock them behind a paid upgrade.

Where can I get support?

Post your question in the WordPress.org support forum. Documentation and video tutorials are also available at wpazleen.com/docs.

Does it work with B2B or wholesale stores?

Yes. The product table layouts with sortable columns, bulk features, and product compare are built for B2B buyers and wholesale operations.

Is it compatible with WordPress 7.0?

Yes. Store Display is fully tested and compatible with WordPress 7.0 “Armstrong”.
